chunks: For it has been narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:
"Whoever recites the tasbih of Fāṭimah al-Zahrāʾ عليها السلام at the end of the obligatory prayer, before folding his legs, Allah will forgive him."

key_terms.الصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the transmitter of this teaching
key_terms.تَسْبِيحَ: the prescribed formula of dhikr known as tasbih
key_terms.سَبَّحَ: recited words of glorification and remembrance of Allah
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ الزَّهْرَاءِ: Sayyidah Fāṭimah al-Zahrāʾ عليها السلام, to whom this tasbih is attributed

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting the Tasbih of Fāṭimah al-Zahrāʾ عليها السلام after the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches the merit of reciting the Tasbih of Fāṭimah al-Zahrāʾ عليها السلام immediately after the obligatory salat. It highlights both the spiritual importance of this dhikr and the special reward of divine forgiveness for performing it without delay after the prayer.
